Inhibits phosphate reabsorption

cards.q: Carbonic anhydrase isoform inhibited by acetazolamide in proximal tubule cells
cards.a: Type II

cards.q: Brush-border carbonic anhydrase isoform inhibited by acetazolamide
cards.a: Type IV

cards.q: Proposed action of acetazolamide in acute mountain sickness
cards.a: Alters CO2 transport; lowers CSF formation and CSF pH

cards.q: Signal transduction of the V1a receptor
cards.a: Phospholipase C, IP3 and DAG; Ca2+ release from stores

cards.q: Antibiotic that partly antagonises vasopressin, used in inappropriate ADH secretion
cards.a: Demeclocycline
Contraction via oxytocin receptors; equipotent with oxytocin before term
About 25 minutes

cards.q: Drug that reduces urine volume in pituitary DI by sensitising the kidney to ADH
cards.a: Chlorpropamide
1-2%; oral dose is 10-15 times the intranasal dose
Use in hypertension has outstripped use in oedema
Intravenous only, as 10-20% solution

cards.q: Only diuretics effective in nephrogenic DI
cards.a: Thiazides
Anti-aquaretics (inhibit water excretion, not salt)
